questions.q_en: Find the area of a trapezium with bases 37 cm and 29 cm and height 53 cm.
questions.solution_en:
The area of a trapezium = 1/2 X (sum of bases) X height

= 1/2 X (37 + 29) X 53

= 1749 cm²

questions.q_en: A rectangular park is 60 m long and 40 m wide. A path of uniform width is constructed inside the park along its edges. If the area of the path is 384 m², find the width of the path.
questions.solution_en:
Total area of the park = 60 X 40 = 2400 m²

Let, x = width of the path

Then the inner rectangle has dimensions (60 - 2x) m and (40 - 2x) m.

Area of the inner rectangle = (60 - 2x)(40 - 2x) m²

Area of the path = Area of outer rectangle - Area of inner rectangle = 2400 - (60 - 2x)(40 - 2x) = 384

So,

(60 - 2x)(40 - 2x) = 2400 - 384 = 2016.

Take x = 2:

(60 - 2 X 2) = 56, (40 - 2 X 2) = 36 → 56 X 36 = 2016.

This satisfies the equation.

Therefore, x = 2 m

questions.q_en: The length of a rectangle is 2/7th of the side of a square and breadth of the rectangle is one-eighth of the side of the square. If the area of the rectangle is 112 m2, then what is the perimeter of the square?
questions.solution_en:
Let side of the square is x m.

So, length of the rectangle = 2x/7 m and breadth of the rectangle = x/8 m

2x/7 * x/8 = 112

=> x2 = 56 * 56

=> x = 56 m

Hence, perimeter of the square = 4 * 56 = 224 m

questions.q_en: The area of a square is 1024 sq.m. What is the perimeter of a rectangle whose length is twice the side of the square and the breadth is half the side of the square?
questions.solution_en:
Let 's' be the side of the square.

Area of the square = s2 = 1024 sq m

s = √1024 = 32 m

Therefore length of the rectangle = 2*32 = 64 m

Therefore breadth of the rectangle = (1/2)*32 = 16 m

Therefore perimeter of the rectangle = 2*(64 + 16) = 160 m.

questions.q_en: Base of a triangle is 3/5 times the length of a rectangle. If breadth of the rectangle is 60 cm and area of the triangle is 21/20 of area of the rectangle, then what is the height of the triangle?

The area of the triangle is 21/20 of area of the rectangle.

=> 1/2 * base * height = 21/20 * Length * 60

=> 1/2 * 3/5 * length * height = 21/20 * length * 60

=> height = 21 * 3 * 5/3 * 2

=> height = 210 cm

questions.q_en: Area of a rectangle is equal to the area of rhombus whose diagonals are 16 mm and 40 mm respectively. What is the perimeter of rectangle if its length is 25 mm?
questions.solution_en:
Area of rectangle = Area of rhombus = (1/2) * product of diagonals

= (1/2) * 16 * 40

= 320 mm2

Then, area of rectangle = length * breadth

320 = 25 * breadth

Breadth of rectangle = 12.8 mm

Therefore, perimeter of rectangle = 2 * (length + breadth)

= 2 * (25 + 12.8)

= 75.6 mm
